converter.dropHint: No upload · Folders OK · Multiple files · ZIP download
converter.privacyVerifyStep1: Open DevTools (F12) → Network tab → enable Preserve log.
converter.privacyVerifyStep2: Convert a HEIC file. Filter by Fetch/XHR or search "upload".
converter.privacyVerifyStep3: You should see no requests carrying your image bytes—only page assets and analytics if you accepted cookies.
converter.privacyVerifyNote: Conversion uses libheif WASM and Canvas in your tab; HeicSave has no upload endpoint for images.
converter.zipError: Could not create ZIP. Try downloading files individually.
converter.qualityHint: Higher = sharper and larger files. Default {default}%.
converter.resizeHint: Scale down wide photos while keeping aspect ratio. Original keeps full resolution.
converter.exifHint: Copy date taken, camera model, and orientation into JPG. GPS is not copied. WebP/PNG ignore this setting.
converter.partialSuccess: {failed} file(s) could not be converted — see errors below.
converter.successOne: 1 file converted — ready to download below.
converter.successMany: {count} files converted — ready to download below.

errors.memory: {file} is too large for this browser tab. Close other tabs, convert fewer files at once, or use Chrome or Edge on a desktop PC.
errors.decodeAvif: {file} could not be decoded as AVIF. Use the latest Chrome or Edge on a desktop—Firefox and older Safari often fail.
errors.decodeWebp: {file} could not be decoded as WebP. Try Chrome or Edge, or re-export from your editor.
errors.decodeGeneric: {file} could not be loaded. The file may be corrupt or use an unsupported variant.
errors.heic: {file} could not be converted from HEIC. Use Chrome or Edge on a desktop, pick a still photo (.heic/.heif, not a Live Photo .mov), and try one file at a time.
errors.security: The browser blocked reading {file}. Reload the page and avoid cross-origin files.
errors.unsupported: Your browser does not support this conversion. Update the browser or switch to Chrome, Edge, or a recent Safari.
errors.generic: Could not convert {file}. Try Chrome or Edge on a desktop, use smaller files, or convert fewer images per batch. ({detail})

warnings.largeBatch: You selected {count} files. Large batches can be slow or fail on phones—try a desktop browser or smaller groups.
warnings.largeFileOne: "{name}" is over {mb} MB. Heavy files need more memory—desktop Chrome or Edge works best.
warnings.largeFileMany: {count} files are over {mb} MB each. Very large images may fail on mobile—use a desktop browser if you see errors.
